observations: Photo 0 shows a light-colored 2 seater couch with rounded arms and backrest; looks like fabric or faux leather upholstery.
Photo 0 shows no obvious large tears; there are visible light scuffs/marks on the seat surface from angle/lighting.
Photo 1 shows the corner/side of the seat and arm; stitching lines are visible and appear intact from this view.
No brand/model label is visible in either photo.

claims.claim: Very neat 2 seater couch for sale
claims.evidence: Photos show a generally clean couch, but only two angles and lighting; small marks/usage are visible.
No receipt/date or tag visible in photos.

claims.claim: no stain, no tear, foam still firm
claims.evidence: No close-up of upholstery for stains; no proof of foam firmness (no sit test).

risks.risk: Hidden stains/odor (smoke, sweat, food) not visible in these two photos
risks.proof: Ask for a close-up video/pan of the entire seat and back (including seams) plus a quick smell/odor check in the video.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with possible minor stains/odor (worst case for comfort/cleaning).

risks.risk: Foam may be sagging or uncomfortable despite no visible tear
risks.proof: Ask for a short video of someone sitting/pressing the seat and back (showing rebound).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully firm/some sagging.

risks.risk: Small tears, loose stitching, or worn piping at edges not captured by the angles
risks.proof: Ask for close-ups of all edges/piping and the underside corners (4 sides).
risks.if_unproven: Price as may need minor repair/cleaning.

risks.risk: Upholstery type/condition (fabric vs faux leather) affects cleaning and resale value
risks.proof: Ask for a close-up of the material texture and any care label/tag.
risks.if_unproven: Price conservatively as generic used upholstery.

proof_requests: Close-up photos of the full seat surface, backrest, and both armrests (including seams).
Video showing someone sitting and pressing the seat to confirm foam firmness/rebound.
Close-ups of edges/piping and the underside corners to check for hidden tears/loose stitching.
Photo of any brand/care label or receipt (to support 'bought new last year').
response.reason: The couch type is clear (2 seater), but key value drivers—foam firmness, hidden stains/odor, and any small damage—cannot be confirmed from only two angled photos. To price confidently, request the sit/press video and full upholstery close-ups.
